prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” roofer for every Dallas home, but **Infinity Roofing** is a strong company to include on your shortlist: it reports holding top-tier certifications from Owens Corning, CertainTeed, and GAF. Those credentials can indicate manufacturer training and may offer access to enhanced warranties, though they don’t guarantee the quality of a particular job. [Infinity Roofing](https://www.infinityroofer.com/dallas-tx/)

Before choosing, get **at least three written, itemized bids** and compare the exact materials, tear-off and disposal, ventilation and flashing work, cleanup, warranty terms, and payment schedule. Verify the contractor’s insurance and recent local references, and don’t feel pressured to sign after a storm.
